remarks: Nestled in the heart of Westport, CT, this elegant home at 138 Roseville Road is a sophisticated blend of timeless charm and modern convenience. The vibe is relaxing yet gracious. Originally built in 1900, this completely renovated 3 bedroom en suite home has impressive marble bathrooms. Beyond the beautiful marble foyer floors are handsome, extra-wide hardwood floor boards which span across the first floor. There are special details throughout the living room including built-ins, a wood burning fieldstone fireplace, extensive millwork and oversized windows. A first floor en suite bedroom can also double as an office. The gourmet kitchen is perfect for entertaining with its marble countertops and beautiful, furniture-like cabinets. There's a custom pantry/coffee bar under the rotunda staircase; it's a terrific use of this space. Ascend through the light-filled rotunda to the 2nd floor primary suite. Relax in the soaking tub in the luxurious marble bath. Step out onto the deck overlooking the back yard. It's the perfect spot to relax at the end of a busy day. There's a 2nd ensuite bedroom on the 2nd floor. There's oversized, detached garage with brand new automated door and car charger has plenty of storage. Natural gas and city water make life easy here. 138 Roseville is a very convenient location, close to schools, transportation, Westport shopping, the dog park & beaches. This is a very unique and special home.
